question.text: 'Mahanadi Private Equity AIF' (non-LVF) has made several changes to its PPM during the financial year 2024-25. By when must the AIF intimate SEBI regarding these consolidated changes?

answer.text: Within 6 months of the end of each financial year
Only at the time of the next scheme launch
Within 1 month of the end of each financial year, on a consolidated basis

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 13.5, AIFs are required to intimate SEBI regarding any changes in terms of the PPM on a consolidated basis, within 1 month of the end of each financial year. This intimation must be routed through a Merchant Banker along with a due diligence certificate (except for LVFs, which can file directly). The Trap: Per-change intimation is not the norm. 6 months applies to PPM audit report. Next-scheme-launch is not tied to the intimation cycle. Cross-Exam Context: XIX-A recalls 1 month. XIX-C requires knowing the consolidated-basis requirement and merchant banker routing (non-LVF). Manager's Pro-Tip: Track PPM changes in a running change-log from Day 1 — makes the 30-day year-end filing painless and reduces merchant banker turnaround time.
